name: Leah Mirsch
office: City of Rolling Hills, Member of the City Council

items.text: Leah Mirsch is a member of the Rolling Hills City Council. She previously served as a planning commissioner. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she said she opposes state housing mandates and by-right increases in home sites and supports amending the California constitution to return land-use decisions to local governments.

sentences.text: Leah Mirsch is a member of the Rolling Hills City Council.
She previously served as a planning commissioner.

In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she said she opposes state housing mandates and by-right increases in home sites and supports amending the California constitution to return land-use decisions to local governments.

items.text: She listed fire safety, disaster preparedness, and preserving community features like privacy and wildlife management as priorities. During the 2024 Palos Verdes Peninsula landslides, she said the city was committed to holding utility companies accountable for shutoffs and restoring service quickly.
